scenarios.title: A｜组队
scenarios.setting: 老师宣布接下来要完成一个三人小组作业。

turns.text: For this project, you’ll work in groups of three. Please form your groups before the end of class.
Hey, have you found a group yet?

turns.prompt: 你想邀请同学一起组队完成作业，会怎么说？

choices.text: Not yet either. Do you want to work together?

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet either. Do you want to work together?
feedback.explanation: “not yet”表示目前还没有，但之后仍可能发生；与绝对否定不同。

choices.text: No. Would you like to be in the same group?

feedback.naturalExpression: No. Would you like to be in the same group?
feedback.explanation: 先询问对方的意愿或偏好，再作安排，让对方参与选择。

choices.text: I’m still looking for a group. Want to team up?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still looking for a group. Want to team up?
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: We could work together if you’re interested.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could work together if you’re interested.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Do you want to make a group with me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet either. Do you want to work together?
feedback.explanation: 合作组队常用“work together / team up”；“make a group”更像在组建正式小组。

turns.text: Sure! We still need one more person, though.

turns.prompt: 你想商量还能邀请谁加入小组，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you know anyone else who’s looking for a group?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know anyone else who’s looking for a group?
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: We could ask Jamie. I don’t think she has a group yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could ask Jamie. I don’t think she has a group yet.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Should we ask around and find one more person?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should we ask around and find one more person?
feedback.explanation: “more / extra / another”表示在已有数量上增加，能说明是补充需求。

turns.text: Hey, Jamie. We’re putting a group together for the project. Would you like to join us?

turns.prompt: 你想确认小组目前的人数，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great! Then we have three people.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great! Then we have three people.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: Perfect. Let’s exchange contact information before we leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Let’s exchange contact information before we leave.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Great. Maybe we can set up a group chat.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Maybe we can set up a group chat.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: B｜分配任务
scenarios.setting: 三名组员开始讨论谁负责什么。

turns.text: Okay, how should we divide up the work?

turns.prompt: 关于「小组作业」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Maybe we should list everything we need to do first.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should list everything we need to do first.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: We could divide the project into three sections.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could divide the project into three sections.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Does anyone have a preference for which part they want to do?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does anyone have a preference for which part they want to do?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: I’m happy to take care of the research part.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to take care of the research part.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: How should we separate our works?

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should list everything we need to do first.
feedback.explanation: 分工用“divide up the work”；“work”指工作量时通常不可数，不说“our works”。

turns.text: I’d rather do the presentation slides if that’s okay.

turns.prompt: 关于「小组作业」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. I can handle the research, then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I can handle the research, then.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: That works for me. Who wants to write the report?

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me. Who wants to write the report?
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Okay. Maybe you can do the slides, I’ll do the research, and Sam can work on the report.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Maybe you can do the slides, I’ll do the research, and Sam can work on the report.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Would you also be able to put everyone’s work together at the end?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you also be able to put everyone’s work together at the end?
feedback.explanation: “together”强调双方一起参与或同处一处，适合商量共同安排。

turns.prompt: 关于「小组作业」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Great. Let’s make sure we’re all using the same format.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s make sure we’re all using the same format.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Sounds good. When should we have our individual parts finished?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. When should we have our individual parts finished?
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Maybe we should finish our parts by Friday so we have time to combine everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we should finish our parts by Friday so we have time to combine everything.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜讨论进度
scenarios.setting: 距离截止日期还有几天，三个人在群里确认进度。

turns.text: How’s everyone doing with their part of the project?

turns.prompt: 你想向组员说明自己目前的进度，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m almost done with the research.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m almost done with the research.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’ve finished most of my part. I just need to check a few things.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve finished most of my part. I just need to check a few things.
feedback.explanation: “a few”表示少量，后接可数名词复数；比只说“一些”更偏向数量不多。

choices.text: I’m on track to finish by Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m on track to finish by Friday.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’ve collected the information, but I still need to organize it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve collected the information, but I still need to organize it.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I’ve almost finished my part already.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m almost done with the research.
feedback.explanation: 这句正确；“already”强调比预期早，若只是平常汇报进度，省略它也足够。

turns.text: I’m a little behind on the slides. I probably need another day.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s okay. Do you think you can finish them by Saturday?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. Do you think you can finish them by Saturday?
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Is there anything we can help you with?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything we can help you with?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: We still have some time. Let’s just make sure everything’s ready before we meet.

feedback.naturalExpression: We still have some time. Let’s just make sure everything’s ready before we meet.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: If you send us what you have, maybe we can help finish the rest.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you send us what you have, maybe we can help finish the rest.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

turns.prompt: 你想安排下一次汇总小组进度的时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Should we meet on Sunday to put everything together?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Should we meet on Sunday to put everything together?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Okay. Let’s check in again on Saturday evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s check in again on Saturday evening.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Sounds good. I’ll send my research to the group when it’s ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. I’ll send my research to the group when it’s ready.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
